item.title: Neonz AR
item.description: AR NFT Viewer In 2021, Sutu launched one of the first generative NFT series on the tezos blockshain, a 10,000 profile pic series called Neonz. This was deveoped by the folks at Eyejack, I got on board to help them with some cool AR rendering effects. I worked on a couple of components of the SUTUVERSE Face filter - https://www.neonz.xyz/neonz-facez NFT ART Viewer - https://www.neonz.xyz/neonz-signz AR Lighting The new ARKit stuff has some awesome new features for spatial perception - you can use either a realtime 3D scanned mesh to composite new types of lighting into a scene.
